     I, ⟦name|Darnell A. Okonkwo-Price⟧, declare under penalty of perjury pursuant to 28 U.S.C. § 1746 as follows:

     1.  I am over eighteen years of age and competent to make this declaration. The facts below are within my personal knowledge.

     2.  I live at ⟦street address|2291 Belvedere Ridge Court, Apartment 6B, Decatur, Georgia 30032⟧, and have lived there since August 2019. I work as a recording engineer at Southside Tracking Rooms in East Point. Most of my work is local, although in 2025 I assisted on two sessions for Usher, and the extra income from that work is why I was in a position to apply for a mortgage last spring.

     3.  My Social Security number is ⟦ssn|XXX-XX-6604⟧. I have never used, applied for, or been issued any other Social Security number.

     4.  On or about April 2, 2026, my loan officer at Peach State Home Lending, ⟦name|Tamsin Ferreira-Lowe⟧, told me by phone that my Meridian report showed a collection account and two late payments I did not recognize. She emailed me the tri-merge report that afternoon from ⟦email address|tferreiralowe@peachstatehl.com⟧. A true copy of the Meridian portion is attached as Exhibit 1.

     5.  The Meridian file contains, in addition to my own information, the following information that does not belong to me:

          (a)  the name "⟦name|DARNELL O PRICE⟧" and the alias "⟦name|D ORLANDO PRICE⟧";
          (b)  a former address of ⟦street address|418 Pio Nono Avenue, Unit 2,
               Macon, GA 31204⟧;
          (c)  a date of birth of ⟦date of birth|11/22/1984⟧ (my own date of birth is different and appears only on sealed Exhibit 2);
          (d)  a telephone number, ⟦phone number|(478) 742-0916⟧; and
          (e)  a Brightline Visa account reported as ⟦credit card number|4147 20XX XXXX 7710⟧, showing 60- and 90-day late payments for November and December 2025.

     6.  I have never lived in Macon and I have never held a Brightline credit card. My only relationship with Brightline Financial is a savings account, no. ⟦account number|XXXXXX3391⟧, opened in 2021, which has never been overdrawn.

     7.  Atlas Recovery Partners reported a collection account, no. ⟦account number|AR-0093318-26⟧, with a balance of $4,812.50, described as "ORIG CRED BRIGHTLINE FIN SVCS." I do not owe this debt and had never heard of Atlas before April 2026.

     8.  On April 9, 2026, I mailed written disputes to both Defendants by certified mail, return receipt requested (article nos. 9589 0710 5270 1184 3361 07 and 9589 0710 5270 1184 3361 14). Copies are Exhibits 3 and 4. In each letter I gave my full name, my current address, the last four digits of my Social Security number and my cell number, ⟦phone number|404-610-2278⟧, and asked that the mixed information be deleted.

     9.  Meridian responded on May 1, 2026 with a form letter stating that the information had been "VERIFIED AS REPORTED" (Exhibit 5). I called the number printed on the letter. The representative gave her name as ⟦name|Krystal⟧ and her operator ID as ⟦employee id|MCR-55120⟧. ⟦name|Krystal⟧ told me the furnisher had "matched on SSN" and that there was nothing further she could do.

     10. Atlas never responded in writing. On June 3, 2026 I received a voicemail from a collector who identified himself as Mr. ⟦name|Dobbs⟧, asking me to call back and "resolve the Brightline matter today."

     11. Because of the mixed file, Peach State withdrew my pre-approval on May 12, 2026. I lost my $750.00 earnest money on the house in Kirkwood and had to sign a new twelve-month lease at $1,940 per month, $215 more than I was paying before.

     12. I have spent more than forty hours on this. My wife, ⟦name|Adaeze⟧, has taken unpaid leave on two occasions to help me assemble documents, and the stress has affected my sleep and my work.

     I declare under penalty of perjury under the laws of the United States of America that the foregoing is true and correct.

I live at the address overleaf with my partner ⟦name|Callum⟧ and our two children. I have lived there for about six years. My front room window looks straight out onto the parking bays at the front of the block.

On Saturday 19th September 2026 at about 21:40 hours I was sat in the front room watching the snooker on the telly. I know the time because Ronnie O'Sullivan had just won the frame and ⟦name|Callum⟧ said it was nearly time to get the kids' stuff ready for the morning.

I heard a loud bang from outside like something metal being hit. I got up and looked through the gap in the blinds. The street lights were on and I could see clearly. There were two men next to the red Nissan Juke that belongs to my neighbour, Mrs ⟦name|Lorna O'Rourke-Bell⟧, who lives at number 12. One man was crouched down by the driver's door and the other was standing at the back of the car looking up and down the road.

I recognised the man standing at the back. I know him as "⟦name|DEANO⟧". I believe his full name is ⟦name|Dean GARSIDE⟧. I have seen him around the estate for at least two years, mostly near the shop on Top Moor Side, and I have spoken to him once or twice to say hello. He is white, about 30, skinny, about 5'9", with short ginger hair and a ginger beard. He was wearing a grey tracksuit with a black puffer jacket and white trainers.

I did not recognise the other man. He was white, heavier build, wearing a dark hoodie with the hood up. I did not see his face properly.

I saw the crouching man pull the driver's door open and the interior light came on. ⟦name|DEANO⟧ then said something like "hurry up, come on". I heard that clearly because our window was open a bit.

I shouted "Oi!" out of the window. Both men looked up at me. ⟦name|DEANO⟧ looked straight at me for a second or two. Then they both ran off towards Holbeck Moor Road and got into a silver van, I think a Ford Transit Custom. I only got part of the registration, I think it began YK19. It drove off fast towards the Domestic Street end.

I phoned 999 straight away. I then rang Mrs ⟦name|O'Rourke-Bell⟧'s son, ⟦name|Tunde⟧, on ⟦phone number|07723 418055⟧ because I have his number from when we set up the street WhatsApp, and he came round within about ten minutes.

I would recognise ⟦name|DEANO⟧ again. I am not sure I would recognise the other man.

I am willing to attend court if required.

I, ⟦name|ROSALIND MEI-LING TREMBLAY-CHAN⟧, of the City of Hamilton, in the Province of Ontario, declare that this is my last Will and Testament.

1.  REVOCATION
I revoke all wills and codicils previously made by me.

2.  APPOINTMENT OF ESTATE TRUSTEE
I appoint my husband, ⟦name|BERNARD JOSEPH TREMBLAY⟧, to be the sole Estate Trustee of this my Will. If my husband dies before me, or dies before the trusts in this Will are fully performed, or is unable or unwilling to act or to continue to act, I appoint my sister, ⟦name|VIVIAN CHAN-OSEI⟧, of the City of Mississauga, and my friend, ⟦name|MAHENDRA RAGHUBIR⟧ (known to my family as "⟦name|Manny⟧"), of the Town of Ancaster, both in the Province of Ontario, to be the Estate Trustees of this my Will in his place. In this Will the expression "my Trustees" means the estate trustee or estate trustees acting from time to time.

3.  GUARDIAN
If my husband dies before me, or is unable to act, I appoint my sister ⟦name|VIVIAN⟧ to be the guardian of the persons of my minor children, namely my daughter ⟦name|ÉLODIE GRACE TREMBLAY-CHAN⟧ (born ⟦date of birth|June 14, 2013⟧) and my son ⟦name|THEO HENRY TREMBLAY-CHAN⟧ (born ⟦date of birth|February 2, 2017⟧), during their minority.

4.  SPECIFIC GIFTS
I direct my Trustees to deliver or pay:
(a)  to my son ⟦name|THEO⟧, if he survives me, my Edmonton Oilers jersey autographed by Wayne Gretzky and the collection of Hamilton Tiger-Cats programmes assembled by my late father, ⟦name|HENRY CHAN⟧;
(b)  to my daughter ⟦name|ÉLODIE⟧, if she survives me, my jade bangle, my grandmother's upright piano and all of my sheet music;
(c)  to ⟦name|MAHENDRA RAGHUBIR⟧, if he survives me, the sum of FIVE THOUSAND DOLLARS ($5,000.00), in gratitude for his friendship;
(d)  to the HAMILTON PUBLIC LIBRARY FOUNDATION (charitable registration number 11904 3352 RR0001), the sum of TEN THOUSAND DOLLARS ($10,000.00), to be used for its children's literacy programs.

5.  REGISTERED PLANS AND DESIGNATIONS
(a)  I confirm the designation of my husband as successor holder of my Tax-Free Savings Account at Meridian Credit Union Limited, account number ⟦account number|0447-3318-209⟧, and nothing in this Will revokes that designation.
(b)  I confirm the designation of my children, in equal shares, as beneficiaries of my group life insurance under Sun Life policy no. ⟦account number|GL 207714-03⟧ provided through my employer, McMaster University, and I declare that the share of any child under the age of twenty-five (25) years shall be held by my Trustees under paragraph 7.

6.  RESIDUE
I give the residue of my estate to my husband if he survives me by thirty (30) days. If he does not, I give the residue in equal shares to those of my children who survive me, subject to paragraph 7.

7.  BENEFICIARIES UNDER TWENTY-FIVE
If any person becomes entitled to any share of my estate before attaining the age of twenty-five (25) years, my Trustees shall hold that share in trust and may pay so much of the income and capital as they consider advisable for that person's support, education and benefit until that person reaches that age.

8.  EXCLUSION FROM NET FAMILY PROPERTY
Any property that a beneficiary receives under this Will, and any income from it, shall be excluded from that beneficiary's net family property within the meaning of the Family Law Act (Ontario).
